subject: CONTINUE statement (precision and maximum size of the arithmetic expression specifying the number of seconds to pause ex
notes: Rule: A.1 item 39 'CONTINUE statement (precision and maximum size of the arithmetic expression specifying the number of seconds to pause execution) ... required ... documented (14.9.9 GR1)'. cite.py --check 14.9.9.4 "The implementor shall specify the value of m, which may be zero, and the value of n, which shall be greater than zero" -> OK §14.9.9.4 1) (General rules). cite.py --check 14.9.9.4 "The implementor shall specify the maximum meaningful value of arithmetic-expression-1" -> OK §14.9.9.4 1). cite.py --check 14.9.9.4 "the maximum meaningful value is placed into the temporary data item" -> OK §14.9.9.4 1). Determination (docs/CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-39): m = 0, n = 5, maximum meaningful value 86,400 s (CobolTiming.MaxSeconds); every larger value is replaced by the maximum before the store, so no digit is lost to n. LANDED (kb/Work PB1529, wave 1018 group G): the interval reaches the runtime ON THE CARRIER IT EVALUATED ON, once (StatementEmitter.ContinueAfterCall, total over NumXCarrier; the emitter narrows nothing), and CobolTiming.ContinueAfter takes the sign (GR1 a-c) and the whole seconds (implicit COMPUTE without ROUNDED, m = 0) from the value in its own domain through the carrier's SATURATING reader CobolNum.PositionOf (Int128 + scale, UInt128 + scale, CobolDec, binary64).
